heroHeading: Accounting, VAT and corporate tax support for businesses in the UAE.
heroIntro: IFRS-aligned books, VAT and corporate tax prepared and reconciled, WPS payroll and a monthly MIS in AED, with INR views if you also operate in India.
overview:
The UAE regime is now VAT plus corporate tax, with payroll running through WPS. Each depends on the quality of your accounting: VAT returns have to reconcile to the ledger, and corporate tax starts from accounting profit. We keep books on an IFRS-aligned chart of accounts with multi-currency support so your numbers support tax, banking and audit.

Delivery runs from our India team. Returns are submitted through your own portal accounts or a licensed tax agent where representation is required. We prepare, reconcile and walk you through approval.
howHeading: What you get in the UAE
howWeServe: Bookkeeping on an IFRS-aligned chart of accounts with multi-currency revaluation.
VAT returns, reconciliation and input tax tracking.
Corporate tax computation, relief and free zone status assessment, and the annual return.
Payroll with WPS files, payslips and gratuity calculation.
Annual statements under IFRS for SMEs, with full IFRS as an add-on.
Bilingual coordination with your licensed auditor and PRO providers.

faqs.q: Do you serve free zone companies?
faqs.a: Yes. We assess free zone status, including Qualifying Free Zone Person conditions, as part of corporate tax relief assessment.

faqs.q: Can you serve us from India?
faqs.a: Yes. Delivery runs from our India team. Registrations, representation and signatures that need local licensing are handled by you or a licensed in-country partner.

faqs.q: Do you work with business-setup firms?
faqs.a: Yes. Our partner programme offers white-label bookkeeping, VAT, corporate tax preparation, payroll and MIS to firms that serve GCC clients.
